answers.evidence:
Reproduced the bug against the committed buggy baseline (`git worktree` at `abb91ab`), applied the fix, and verified with a child-process harness (`test/run-tests.mjs`, 21 assertions) run via `npm test`:

| Check | Buggy | Fixed |
|---|---|---|
| Harness result | **10 failed** | **21/21 passed** |
| Outside-project exit code | 2 | 1 |
| `mythos init` hint on stderr | missing | present |
| Absolute provider path (`/providers/fs.js`) leak | leaked | absent by default, shown only under `--verbose`/`MYTHOS_VERBOSE=1` |
| Backend service sees `MYTHOS_VERBOSE` | undefined | `1` with flag, `0` without |
| In-project `init`+`batch` | n/a | exit 0, "Batch finished" |
| Unrelated fatal (unknown command) | exit 2 | exit 1, `Fatal error:` prefix kept |

Edge cases covered: env-only verbosity (`MYTHOS_VERBOSE=1` without flag gates diagnostics on — T5), stale parent env normalized to explicit `1`/`0` rather than pass-through (T7), verbose outside-project still exits 1 with hint (T2), StorageError detection via `name` as well as `instanceof` to survive module duplication. Verified from clean state: `rm -rf dist && npm test` → `21 passed, 0 failed`.
